meta.title: QPSK: twice the bits, same BER
meta.tools: Monte Carlo (NumPy), Gray-mapped QPSK, constellation and SER theory
meta.summary: Show that Gray-coded QPSK carries 2 bits/symbol with exactly the BPSK bit-error rate per E_b/N₀, measure the symbol error rate against 2Q − Q², and demonstrate the double data rate in the same bandwidth.
meta.problem: How can QPSK double the data rate without costing any power efficiency?
meta.theory:
QPSK = two independent BPSK streams on cos and sin (I and Q). Per bit the energy and noise are unchanged, so
$P_b=Q(\sqrt{2E_b/N_0})$; symbol error $P_s=2Q-Q^2$ with $Q=Q(\sqrt{E_s/N_0})$, $E_s=2E_b$. Spectral efficiency 2 bit/s/Hz (Nyquist)
vs 1 for BPSK.
meta.method: 10⁶ symbols per point, Gray map 00→(+,+), 01→(−,+), 11→(−,−), 10→(+,−), AWGN, minimum-distance decisions.
